item.title: AWS Experience-Based Acceleration: Turning Cloud Ambitions into Working Solutions in Two Days
item.dc:creator: Swaroop Anand
item.content:encoded:
When the right people, tools and experience come together, transformation moves faster

Imagine building a house.

You have the architect, the builders, the electricians and all the materials. Everyone knows what needs to be done, but progress is slow because people are working independently. The architect is waiting for approval, the electrician needs clarification, and the builders cannot move forward until someone resolves a dependency.

Now imagine a different situation.

item.title: I don’t read financial news. So I built a system that reads it for me.
item.dc:creator: Swaroop Anand
item.content:encoded:
Gold crashed 3.1% on Friday. I found out an hour later when I randomly checked my broker app. By then the move was done.

That was the last straw.
